entities.name: Lutri
entities.description: A mischievous elemental otter of Ikoria.

entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: Vivien's bow, whose effect Lutri imitated with a stolen arrow.

events.summary: Lutri steals an arrow from Vivien Reid's quiver and releases a creature as if shot by the Arkbow, then vanishes.
events.quote: once stole an arrow from the quiver of the planeswalker Vivien Reid

events.summary: Lutri fights in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Lutri fought in defense of Ikoria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
